snippet.description:
Hello? I'm Sweet Color😄

Let's write and read Alphabet A to Z while listening to the Alphabet song and exciting classical music.

🌈Let's play alphabet games looking at various colors~🌈

I hope you have a good time and please subscribe and like it👍

Thank you very much😃

🌈다양한 색깔 보며 알파벳 놀이를 해봐요~🌈

Hello? I'm Sweet Color😄

Let's write and read Alphabet A to Z while listening to the Alphabet song and exciting classical music.

🌈Let's play alphabet games looking at various colors~🌈

I hope you have a good time and please subscribe and like it👍

Thank you very much😃


안녕하세요? 스위트컬러입니다😄

Alphabet song과 신나는 클래식 음악을 들으며 알파벳 A부터 Z까지 따라 쓰고 읽어 보아요~

🌈다양한 색깔 보며 알파벳 놀이를 해봐요~🌈

유익한 시간되시길 바라며, 구독과 좋아요 부탁드려요

감사합니다😃
